wiki_article: **Operative Feminism — Citational Comprehensivity Pass** is a navigation map by Lee Sharks, dated 6 April 2026. It is a **TANG — Total Axial Negation Graph of feminism**, roughly 6,300 words covering **200+ texts, 130+ thinkers, and 21 strata** running from **Enheduanna (c. 2285 BCE)** — the earliest named author in world literature — **to the anti-gender backlash of the 2020s**. Its captured description says it **restores the original meaning of TANG**, which the ΩTANG specification at #1350 defines: build a domain's total citational graph, map every node and every edge **including who ignores whom**, and at sufficient density **the centre drops out** — the apparent core of a field revealed as an artifact of partial mapping. Feminism is an apt test case, being a field whose canon-formation disputes are themselves part of its subject matter. The record was held as a metadata capture until 8 August 2026, when the canonical text was recovered from the authorial blog surface and seated as the body.
